title: [Decision] The report page offers only "Edit": should a shipped report get a time-range filter, export and subscription, and in which order
body:
Ruled: 6408567749 · letter B · 2026-10-26T05:02Z

Filing gate **② a decision only the maintainer can make** (new capability; the four facets below). Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (second batch, 8 cards). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim.

## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 打开任何一张报表（如 Opportunities by Stage），页面只有标题、一张图、一张表和右上角「编辑」。没有时间范围、没有导出、没有订阅。销售经理拿到报表后最常问的三件事（这是哪段时间？能导出吗？能每周发我吗？）一个都答不了。仪表盘有时间范围筛选，报表没有。
- **要决定的事：** 要不要给报表页加这三项能力；加的话按什么顺序。每一项都是新的平台面，一经声明就要长期维护。
- **怎么回：** 回一个字母（A / B / C / D）。

## What was measured

- HotCRM → 报表 → Opportunities by Stage: header 「Opportunities by Stage · Summary of opportunities grouped by stage」, button 「编辑」, one bar chart, one table with 总计. No filter bar, no export, no date range. [94-report-opps-by-stage.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/94-report-opps-by-stage.png).
- Dashboards on the same console carry a date-range chip (本季度 / 近 90 天) and per-dimension filters; the report renderer has neither.
- The ten HotCRM reports are all-time aggregates; a report that says "Lead Inflow" over all time is a different number from last quarter's, and the page cannot say which.

## Governing text

- `@objectstack/spec` report schema (what a report may declare today: dataset, chart, columns, grouping); the dashboard `globalFilters` / `dateRange` already exist on the dashboard schema (objectui#10339 pins its default).
- pm-dispatch 〈升级与决策〉 facet ④: 创业阶段不扩散 — a new declared surface is a permanent obligation; the recommendation must show pull.

## Options

| option | what it does | what a manager gets | effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A. Time range only** | reports reuse the dashboard's `dateRange` filter when the dataset has a time dimension; no export, no subscription | answers "which period" | spec S + objectui M |
| **B. Time range + export** | A, plus CSV / XLSX export of the report table through the existing list-export permission | answers "which period" and "can I have it in Excel" | A + objectui S (export already exists for lists) |
| **C. All three** | B, plus a scheduled subscription (email the report on a cadence) | the full manager loop | B + objectstack job + messaging M, a new scheduled-work surface |
| **D. None now** | the report page stays as is; dashboards carry the filters | unchanged | none |

Business reading: A = "a report is a dated query, not a snapshot"; B = "a report is something you take to a meeting"; C = "a report comes to you"; D = "reports are a dashboard appendix".

## Recommendation

**B.** Two years out the report page should be what every CRM user expects: pick the period, read it, export it. Both halves reuse surfaces the platform already has (the dashboard's date range, the list export and its permission), so B adds almost no new contract. Subscription (C) is the one genuinely new surface (scheduled delivery, recipients, failure handling) and has no customer pull measured yet; it waits.

- Confidence gap: no customer has asked for any of the three in a card the pass could find; the pull is the tester's reading of what a sales manager does with a report.
- Self-check: looking only at ① → B. Do ②③④ flip it? No; ④ is what keeps C out.

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：A/B 复用仪表盘的时间范围与列表导出，几乎不新增契约；C 新增定时投递面。
- ② 实际业务拉动：时间范围与导出是报表的基本动作，缺它们报表只是仪表盘的附录；订阅目前零拉动。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：报表声明 dateRange 后，AI 写的「本季度线索」报表才有机器可校验的时间窗，而不是靠标题里的词。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：B 止步于已有面的复用；C 的调度、收件人、失败处理每一项都是永久义务，默认推迟。

Prior rulings read: objectui#10339 (dashboard dateRange default), objectui#11694 (report page first screen), hotcrm#2194 (UX decision batch, no report item) → none rules on report filters; thread: none.

## After the ruling

- A or B: spec card first (report `dateRange` / export flag), then the objectui renderer card; HotCRM declares the range on its ten reports once released.
- C: as B plus an objectstack card for the scheduled delivery.
- D: close.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` objectui "report page date range filter export subscribe schedule" → 0 hits. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §4.
